ruling: Sam, in session 2026-11-11: fill the exhibits' missing subject as automatically as possible; a complete canonical ecosystem is a good one, even if imperfect; ASE MIL7 is automotive, not HVAC. Rule decided by SkyTamarind (Session 638): courses at several colleges, then one college, then the issuer family; title words, TOP and CIP never decide
rule: A credential with no Common SUBJ takes the subject of the courses colleges credit for it (over half of them, several colleges first, then one), else its issuer family's; title words, TOP and CIP never decide; a family or certification link that names another subject holds it for a person; a subject already on the title always wins.
